segments.name: Autonomous Last Mile
segments.description: Builds and runs a network of smart lockers, a marketplace, and AI services for drone and robot package delivery.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a 1 single reportable segment, as the CODM, the Chief Executive Officer ("CEO"), evaluates the business as a whole and does not receive discrete financial information for multiple business units.

revenueModel.text: Planned model: customers pay monthly or annual subscription fees for network access, plus installation and related services.
revenueModel.evidence: We plan to offer access to this network through monthly and annual subscription fees, along with associated installation, support, maintenance, and infrastructure services.
